3090-5571-8249--6.description:
Use Harmless Offering to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat from step 2.

907-2645-3181-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2645-3181-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2023-4068-4770-6006.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2023-4068-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-6559.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-1734-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6154.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning White Plume Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

855-2445-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

397-5670-7399.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-5670-7399.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

206-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
206-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4094-4289-7296.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

5231-6528-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1247-6006-7008.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

147-997-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

3812-4613-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Steelswarm Operator using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3812-4613-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-1283-6573-6577.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone three times this game.
112-1283-6573-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

3617-6333-6336.description:
Cast Time Walk from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Haystack by paying {2} and tapping it, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1799-2048-4659-5359.description:
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

440-671-1339-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-671-1339-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
When the Insect dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-2533-3388-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
Repeat.

478-2821-3664-3756-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3664-3756-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

1238-2351-3967-4452-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

467-1379-1912-1978-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
467-1379-1912-1978-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

345-1636-3000-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
"Squirrel" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-1636-3000-4170.description:
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a creature you control, creating a Treasure artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure and Squirrel tokens, you may activate Fain's other abilities.

2073-4241-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a noncreature artifact with mana value equal to one.
2073-4241-4659.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing any noncreature artifact with mana value one to become a 1/1 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact, adding {C}{C}.
The artifact dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

280-1479-3585.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-3585.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Greensleeves, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1037-1491-5007.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling and Multani's Harmony attached to Morselhoarder.
Morselhoarder does not have summoning sickness.
1037-1491-5007.description:
Activate Morselhoarder by tapping it to add a mana of any color.
Activate Sinking Feeling, by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on Morselhoarder to untap it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it to add a mana of any color.
Repeat.
